propositions: clear_absent is structurally unreachable on healthy in-window passes due to call-site gating on out-of-window-but-alive keys, but the idempotency fixture seeds every key in-window, leaving binding_lifecycle absence/tombstone cluster with no integration-tier mutation oracle
the bound-but-absent direct GET runs through a real backend transport that issues 404s for synthetic keys instead of the test harness fake transport
test harness must be extended with out_of_window and deleted key sets on _FakeJiraState, filtered by search_issues and raising HTTPError(404) for deleted keys on direct GET
reconcile_run_differs must be pre-registered and _load_reconcile_backend monkeypatched to wire JiraBackend with fake transport so the reconciliation pass reaches clear_absent for out-of-window keys
clear_absent must preserve updated_at when processing an absence-free binding (change-gate oracle) and must correctly reset the absence counter when transitioning from deleted to alive
